findings.description: Proposed regression test would hang: main() awaits waitForChild(); a fake child that never closes + a setTimeout fake that only captures delay never settles the promise.
findings.resolution: US-002 AC + Files-to-modify now require settling the awaited main() promise (invoke the captured timeout callback so waitForChild resolves to 124, then await + assert captured delay === 1200000), mirroring the existing 'wrapper timeout ... returns 124' test.

findings.description: Plan overstated that raising the default helps 'plan/brainstorm/review lenses simultaneously'. Under Claude Code the research/review SKILLs still wrap codex-exec in a Bash tool timeout: 300000, which can hard-kill a healthy run at 5 min before the new 20-min default is reached.
findings.resolution: Research-brief + plan Research-Findings narrowed: full help for the no-outer-timeout iteration-engine/review-loop paths and Copilot-CLI lenses; only PARTIAL help for Claude-Code SKILL lenses. Added an AC requiring the CHANGELOG/AGENTS text to narrow the guarantee and note outer SKILL Bash timeouts. SKILL Bash-timeout raise filed as an Open Question / follow-up.

findings.description: Plan claimed 'no orphan regression' unconditionally; under Claude Code an immediate uncatchable SIGKILL would bypass the SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers.
findings.resolution: Technical Constraints reworded engine-honestly: no harness hard-kill under Copilot CLI (no regression); under Claude Code a SIGTERM is caught by the v5.54.0 handlers (no orphan), only an immediate SIGKILL bypasses them — a narrow, pre-existing window independent of this constant.

findings.description: Because the plan updates .codex-plugin/plugin.json + marketplace entries, the verification ACs should include the Ralph Codex-artifact release-gate checks (generate-copilot-artifacts --target=codex --check, test-codex-generator.mjs) and the Copilot gate, not just the marketplace-policy validator.
findings.resolution: US-003 ACs + plan Acceptance-Criteria now require the Copilot release gate and the Codex release gate in addition to validate-codex-marketplace-policy.mjs.

findings.description: The 'grep 300 returns only legitimate hits or none' AC is too loose for an autonomous agent.
findings.resolution: Tightened the AC to concrete forbidden phrases (`~300s`, `under 300s`, `harness tool-timeout`, `harness bound`), allowing an unrelated bare numeric 300.
